name: Disk Space Watchdog with Tiered Thresholds
description: Check disk usage over SSH on a schedule, warn at 80% and 90%, and alert only when a mountpoint changes level - no repeated alerts for the same full disk. Telegram with e-mail fallback.

setupVars.label: disk crit pct (was the n8n environment variable DISK_CRIT_PCT)
disk warn pct (was the n8n environment variable DISK_WARN_PCT)
tg chat id (was the n8n environment variable TG_CHAT_ID)
smtp to (was the n8n environment variable SMTP_TO)

source.n8nName: Disk space watchdog with tiered thresholds and Telegram alert

setup: Setup value diskCritPct: disk crit pct (was the n8n environment variable DISK_CRIT_PCT). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value diskWarnPct: disk warn pct (was the n8n environment variable DISK_WARN_PCT). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value tgChatId: tg chat id (was the n8n environment variable TG_CHAT_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value smtpTo: smtp to (was the n8n environment variable SMTP_TO). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate disk-space-watchdog-with-tiered-thresholds.

hints: "Check Disk Usage (SSH)": the original used SSH; check the mapped ssh/SSH_RUN_COMMAND params before running.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect ssh: `cdecli credential create -n "ssh" -p ssh --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
